newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel to eye 129.86 contract high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel to eye 129.86 contract high.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will continue to look positive on Tuesday and have the potential to reach up and test the contract high at 129.86, technical analysts said.

"We broke out of a triangle a couple of days ago so on that we look reasonably positive," said Miranda Churchill, an independant technical anlayst in London. "The (upside) potential for today is 129.86."
Churchill said before reaching that level notionnel would meet some resistance at 129.70, from a short-term channel.
At 0759 GMT, Septmeber notionnel was at 129.18, down 0.02.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London agreed that a test of the contract high was possible on Tuesday.
He said in early morning trade notionnel futures had retraced just over 50 percent of Monday's trading range from 128.74 up to 129.52.
"We are now seeing gains from there," he said. "Initial resistance is at 129.36, an intra day high, and then there is a yesterday's high at 129.52."
Once that level was taken out, Branigan said 129.86 would come into view.
Analysts said the downside potential for notionnel futures was limited.
"You really can't get totally negative on this market unless you take out the gap that was opened last week," said Churchill.
A gap was left between the 128.40 June 12 high and 128.44 June 13 low.
"If we come down through 129.12, a 62 percent retracement of the 128.74, 129.52 rally comes in at 129.02," said Branigan, "with losses through there targeting 128.74."
September Pibor futures were at 96.57, down 0.02 on the day.
